decisions.reason: Although it is close to the firm’s core knowledge, the lack of continued website presence after launch and the stronger strategic pull toward more automated finishing suggest reallocating effort from this standard binder to better-fitting offerings.

This fully automatic perfect binder builds directly on the firm’s existing finishing expertise and matches its stated direction toward automation, so its strong knowledge fit makes it worthwhile to continue supporting and commercialising.

An inline and nearline booklet maker fits the firm’s established digital finishing portfolio and customer base well, and that high relatedness gives the firm good capacity to sell, service, and learn around it despite limited public evidence after launch.
